text:
marta: Heads-up — product asked for updated GPU-hour forecast for embedding + rerank for the Q3 marketing ramp. Need separate pools, and want cost vs latency tradeoffs. Can we get a quick thumb-rule by EOD?

alex: Quick notes: embedding batch is ~70% of current GPU-hours but runs offline. Rerank is bursty realtime, smaller total hours but needs low p50 latency.

sasha: Agree. My rough: embeddings batch currently 18k GPU-hrs/month, rerank realtime ~4.5k GPU-hrs/month on shared pool.

ryan: FYI eu-west has limited H100 availability in July — we'd hit queuing if we colocate rerank there. Might need to route rerank to us-west for peak windows.

capacity-bot: Reserved capacity snapshot — total reserved GPUs: 240; used (30d avg): 178; reserved H100: 60; reserved A100: 120; free: 32.

marta: Thanks. Two asks: (1) propose pool split (dedicated vs shared) and autoscale policy; (2) estimate incremental reserved GPU-hours if product grows 3x during promo week. Keep options: keep batch in cheaper spot/preemptible, and rerank on dedicated low-latency pool.

alex: Proposal A (low cost): keep embeddings in spot/AZ batch cluster, scale to 80k GPU-hrs/month when batch window expands, rerank stays on shared but with higher priority qps -> incremental reserved ~+40 GPUs during promo week.

alex: Proposal B (SLO-first): create a small dedicated rerank pool (40-50 H100-equivalent) with autoscale min 10/max 60, embeddings separate spot fleet. This raises reserved commit by ~50 GPUs, but p50 latency drops ~30-40ms in sim.

jen: Can we quantify cost diff? Back-of-envelope: extra 50 reserved H100-equivalent @ $x/hr -> ~+$120k/month (we should run real calc).

ryan: Also consider mixing quantized model variant for rerank (sparingly) to reduce GPU usage per request. But accuracy/regression risk — needs evals.

marta: Good point re evals. For now include a soft fallback: if dedicated pool saturated, route rerank to a cheaper A100 pool with small latency penalty and signal product.

capacity-bot: Sim run requested by alex: queued. ETA 2 hours. Inputs: 3x traffic surge, region split eu:40% us:50% apac:10, batch window shift +6 hrs.

sasha: After the sim, can we get a minute-by-minute occupancy trace? helps SRE to size autoscale cooldown and pre-warm buffer.

alex: Will add occupancy traces + peak tail latency. Also I'll include cost deltas for reserved vs burst capacity.

marta: Perfect. If sim aligns with Proposal B, we'll ask finance for a short-term commit for promo week and revisit. Otherwise we'll fallback to spot-batch + smart routing.

ryan: One more: network egress spikes during batch windows historically caused transient throttles. Recommend we throttle batch egress and run staggered shards to avoid cross-AZ egress bottlenecks.

jen: Noted. I'll add egress cap to the plan and estimate penalty on batch completion time.

marta: Great work team. Action items: alex run sim + outputs; sasha add occupancy traces; jen cost + egress estimate. Ping here when results are in. :pray:
